thread:
Nora: heads-up — I cant get the live stream. hit a CORS error on the player. anyone else?
Ethan: same for me. the embed just spins. tried mobile and desktop.
AV Team: saw a spike on the ingest nodes. checking now. pinged @DevOps.
DevOps Bot: [automated] ingest-service-1 reported 503 errors in us-central-1. throttling rule triggered. initiating temporary bypass to ingest-fallback-2.
Maya: urgent: we need a backup plan if recording stops. can we enable the Zoom dial-in and have someone record locally?
Nora: yes, good call. Zane can you grab a laptop and record in case the stream recorder flaps?
Zane: on it. grabbing MacBook Pro + local OBS. will drop file to s3://rdw-allhands/backup/ after.
MeetingBot: Reminder in 5m: all-hands scheduled for 10:00 PST. Auto-post to #general will happen at start.
Ethan: can we also push the roadmap block later? want to ensure product demo isn't interrupted.
Nora: agree. propose: 1) company updates, 2) short demos, 3) Q&A (open mic + thread), 4) roadmap last. Anyone object?
Maya: fine by me. leadership: well surface pricing and Dedicated questions in Q&A.
AV Team: ingest-fallback-2 online. stream health: nominal. starting a 60s graceful drain to shift sessions.
DevOps Bot: [automated] mirror-recording enabled: s3://rdw-allhands/2025-01-12-mirror-1742059876.webm. checksum pending.
Ethan: shoutout: the calendar invite still shows the old start time for the roadmap deep-dive. can someone edit the invite so attendees know its moved to end?
Nora: taking that. editing invite now and adding note about slides being uploaded after the meeting.
Zane: local recorder started. writing to /tmp/allhands-1742059876.obs -> uploading when done.
AV Team: suggestion: if the stream degrades, switch to audio-only for the demo to preserve continuity.
Maya: noted. leadership — would you prefer we do audio-only fallback or continue with Q&A in the thread if video dies?
Nora: prefer video if possible, but if we hit >30s buffer issues, switch to audio-only and continue Q&A in thread.
Ethan: tiny request: include timestamps in the S3 README for question segments so folks can jump to answers.
Nora: will do. Zane — can you time-mark important Q&A answers when you upload?
Zane: yep. Ill add a timestamps.txt next to the video with HH:MM:SS -> topic mapping.
DevOps Bot: [automated] ingest-fallback failover complete. packet loss 0.05%.
AV Team: rolling preview looks clean. starting the meeting 2m late. posting a short note to #general.
MeetingBot: @channel All-hands is starting shortly. We have enabled backup recording and adjusted the agenda: roadmap moved to end.
Maya: thanks — will start the Q&A queue in this thread for remote attendees. leadership, see Jordans question pinned below about Private parity.
Nora: acknowledged. Jordan: will answer during Q&A. If we run out of time, well follow up with a doc and office hours.
Ethan: thanks everyone. if recording link doesnt appear after meeting, ping me and Ill chase S3 permissions.
Zane: upload will include ACL: private, shared link will be posted to #all-hands when ready.
Nora: starting now. thanks team for the quick pivot!
